name: prefix_sum_block_carry
task: This project answers range-sum queries over an integer array using a prefix-sum (scan) table, split across multiple translation units: include/data_gen.h + src/data_gen.cpp (a deterministic random-vector generator), include/prefix_sum.h + src/prefix_sum.cpp (serial and OpenMP-parallel inclusive scan), include/range_query.h + src/range_query.cpp (answer_range_sums(), built on inclusive_scan_parallel()), and src/main.cpp (the profiling entry point). inclusive_scan_parallel() in src/prefix_sum.cpp splits the array into one contiguous block per thread inside '#pragma omp parallel' and lets each thread scan only its own block. A scan has a loop-carried dependency (output[i] depends on everything before i), so each block must additionally be shifted by the total of all preceding blocks; that second phase is missing, every block restarts from zero, and the output is correct only for the first block. answer_range_sums() in src/range_query.cpp inherits the error. Fix inclusive_scan_parallel() so it returns exactly the same vector as inclusive_scan_serial() for every input size (including empty inputs and inputs shorter than the thread count) and every number of threads, while keeping the work distributed over OpenMP threads (do not simply call the serial version or remove the parallel region; the usual approach is a two-pass block scan: local scans, a synchronization point, then adding each block's offset). Do not change any function signature declared in include/prefix_sum.h, include/range_query.h or include/data_gen.h.
notes: build_command compiles the profiling entry point at build/app (src/main.cpp -> data_gen.cpp, prefix_sum.cpp, range_query.cpp). This binary must be built and then executed via run_command to drive DiscoPoP's instrumentation and produce its dynamic profiling output, including dynamic_dependencies, over the per-thread scan loop in inclusive_scan_parallel(). test_command builds and runs a separate correctness harness at build/run_tests (from tests/test_main.cpp); it is independent of the profiling binary and should not be used as the DiscoPoP execution target. Both binaries link the same data_gen.cpp, prefix_sum.cpp, range_query.cpp object files, so no separate CMake/Meson/etc. configuration is required — plain 'make' is sufficient to build, run, and test.
